sentences.text: Getting less sleep has become a bad habit for most American kids.
According to a new survey by the National Sleep Foundation, 51% of kids aged 10 to 18 go to bed at 10 pm or later on school nights, even though they have to get up early.
Last year the Foundation reported that nearly 60% of 7- to 12-year-olds said they felt tired during the day, and 15% said they had fallen asleep at school.

paras.zh: 睡眠不足已经成为大多数美国孩子的坏习惯。根据美国国家睡眠基金会的一项新调查，51% 的 10 至 18 岁孩子在上学日的晚上 10 点或更晚才上床睡觉，尽管他们第二天必须早起。去年该基金会报告说，近 60% 的 7 至 12 岁孩子表示白天感到疲倦，还有 15% 的孩子说他们在学校里睡着过。

sentences.text: How much sleep you need depends a lot on your age.
Babies need a lot of rest: most of them sleep about 18 hours a day!
For most school-age children, ten hours is ideal.
But the new National Sleep Foundation survey found that 35% of 10- to 12-year-olds get only seven or eight hours.
And guess what almost half of the surveyed kids said they do before bedtime?

paras.zh: 你需要多少睡眠在很大程度上取决于你的年龄。婴儿需要大量休息，他们中的大多数每天要睡大约 18 个小时！成年人大约需要 8 个小时。对大多数学龄儿童来说，10 个小时是最理想的。但是国家睡眠基金会的这项新调查发现，35% 的 10 至 12 岁孩子只能睡七八个小时。猜猜看，将近一半接受调查的孩子说他们睡前会做什么？看电视。

sentences.text: "More children are going to bed with TVs on, and there are more opportunities to stay awake, with more homework, the Internet and the phone," says Dr. Mary Carskadon, a sleep researcher at Brown University Medical School.
She says these activities at bedtime can get kids all excited and make it hard for them to calm down and sleep.
Other experts say part of the problem is chemical.
Changing levels of body chemicals called hormones not only make teenagers bodies develop adult characteristics, but also make it hard for teenagers to fall asleep before 11 pm.

paras.zh: 布朗大学医学院的睡眠研究人员玛丽·卡斯卡登博士说，越来越多的孩子开着电视上床睡觉，而且随着作业增多以及网络和手机的普及，让人保持清醒的诱惑也越来越多。她说，睡前进行这些活动会让孩子变得非常兴奋，使他们难以平静下来入睡。其他专家则认为，问题的部分原因在于化学因素。被称为激素的人体化学物质水平的变化，不仅使青少年的身体发育出成人特征，也使他们难以在晚上 11 点之前入睡。

sentences.text: Because sleepiness is such a problem for teenagers, some school districts have decided to start high school classes later than they used to.
Three years ago, schools in Edina, Minnesota, changed the start time from 7:25 am to 8:30 am.
Students, parents and teachers are pleased with the results.

paras.zh: 由于困倦对青少年来说是个如此严重的问题，一些学区已经决定把高中的上课时间比过去推迟。三年前，明尼苏达州伊代纳的学校把上课时间从早上 7:25 改为 8:30。学生、家长和老师都对这一结果感到满意。
